question_text: What effects does a pillion passenger have on driving a motorcycle?

options.text: Driving off is more difficult because a motorcycle only becomes stable at higher speeds
The motorcycle becomes more susceptible to side wind
The motorcycle's braking behaviour can change

correct_answers.text: Driving off is more difficult because a motorcycle only becomes stable at higher speeds
The motorcycle becomes more susceptible to side wind
The motorcycle's braking behaviour can change

comment: Having a passenger sitting behind you will increase your weight which makes starting to drive and gaining speed more difficult, it will also increase your breaking distance to stop. Given that it creates more side surface, it increases your sensitivity to side winds

question_text: You want to take a passenger on your motorcycle. What should you pay attention to before you drive off?

options.text: Your passenger has to wear a prescribed helmet
Agree on the conduct during the journey
Carefully and cautiously familiarize inexperienced passengers with riding on a motorbike

correct_answers.text: Your passenger has to wear a prescribed helmet
Agree on the conduct during the journey
Carefully and cautiously familiarize inexperienced passengers with riding on a motorbike

comment: When taking an inexperienced passenger with you, make sure that he wears a helmet, agrees on how to behave during the ride and gradually get used to the new environment

question_text: What must you remember if you want to take a pillion passenger?

options.text: The motorcycle must be licensed to carry 2 persons
There must be a safety helmet for the pillion passenger
No safety helmet is required for the pillion passenger when driving in built-up areas

correct_answers.text: The motorcycle must be licensed to carry 2 persons
There must be a safety helmet for the pillion passenger

comment: When taking another passenger ensure that he wears a helmet and that the motorcycle is licensed to have him on board

question_text: What must you point out to your pillion passenger before setting off?

options.text: - must put his feet on the footrests
- must wear a safety helmet
- must always lean to the outside on bends

correct_answers.text: - must put his feet on the footrests
- must wear a safety helmet

comment: Make sure that your passenger wears a helmet, keeps his feet on the footrests (otherwise it increases the risk of accident and injury). Your passenger does not have to lean to the outside of the bend to compensate when turning

question_text: You want to take a five-year old child on your motorized bicycle. Which seats are permissible for this?

options.text: A special child's seat with footrests
Luggage rack with a cushion
Tank with attached padding

correct_answers.text: A special child's seat with footrests

comment: In order to carry a child as a passenger, you need a special child seat with footrests

question_text: Why is it dangerous if passengers sitting in the rear do not wear their seatbelts?

options.text: - could result in injuries even at low speeds
- could result in injuries to persons in the front seats
- could propel these persons from the vehicle

correct_answers.text: - could result in injuries even at low speeds
- could result in injuries to persons in the front seats
- could propel these persons from the vehicle

comment: In the event of a collision, people on the rear seats can be thrown forward or sideways. If they are thrown forward, the front backrests do not provide adequate protection. As a result, the driver and co-driver are at risk. Even at low speeds, injuries can occur.

question_text: To what should you pay attention if you want to take a passenger on the motorbike?

options.text: The passenger should also be wearing protective motorcycling clothing
The chassis should be adjusted accordingly
The tyre inflation pressure should be adjusted

correct_answers.text: The passenger should also be wearing protective motorcycling clothing
The chassis should be adjusted accordingly
The tyre inflation pressure should be adjusted

comment: When increasing the load on your motorcycle, make sure to increase the tire pressure, adjust the chassis/suspension. Your passenger should also wear a helmet and protective gear

question_text: What must you be aware of if you want to take a pillion rider with you?

options.text: The motorbike must be licensed to carry 2 people
The pillion rider must be capable of riding with you
A child pillion rider over 7 years of age, must be able to use the existing footrests and hand grips

correct_answers.text: The motorbike must be licensed to carry 2 people
The pillion rider must be capable of riding with you
A child pillion rider over 7 years of age, must be able to use the existing footrests and hand grips

comment: The passenger(s) must be physically and mentally able to ride, and the motorbike must be adequately equipped.

question_text: How does riding with a pillion rider affect the handling of a motorbike?

options.text: It is more difficult to keep the motorbike stable
Its behaviour changes when braking
There is a reduction in its sensitivity to side winds

correct_answers.text: It is more difficult to keep the motorbike stable
Its behaviour changes when braking

comment: The pillion rider's own movement destabilises the motorbike. Riding with a passenger should be practised.

question_text: You want to transport a pillion passenger and luggage on your motorbike. What must you be aware of?

options.text: The maximum authorised mass may not be exceeded
Pieces of luggage must be securely fastened
Lighting systems may not be obscured

correct_answers.text: The maximum authorised mass may not be exceeded
Pieces of luggage must be securely fastened
Lighting systems may not be obscured

comment: You must not exceed the permissible total weight for the motorbike. This is made up of the unladen weight and the maximum permitted load. To prevent luggage from flying around, it must be securely fastened. The lighting equipment must be visible at all times and must not be obscured by the loaded luggage.

question_text: You want to transport a pillion passenger. What must you ensure before commencing your journey?

options.text: - that my pillion passenger is wearing a suitable helmet
- I have instructed my pillion passenger on how to behave while we are driving on the road
- the bike's technical adjustment settings for carrying a pillion passenger are used

correct_answers.text: - that my pillion passenger is wearing a suitable helmet
- I have instructed my pillion passenger on how to behave while we are driving on the road
- the bike's technical adjustment settings for carrying a pillion passenger are used

comment: In principle, when a pillion passenger is carried, the passenger seat, footrests and a holding device must be available on the motorbike. Both rider and pillion passenger must wear a suitable safety helmet while riding. To ensure a safe ride, you must instruct the pillion passenger on the correct behaviour before the ride.

question_text: What should you anticipate if you want to take a pillion passenger with you?

options.text: The vehicle's handling will be different when cornering
The overtaking distance may be longer
The braking distance will be reduced

correct_answers.text: The vehicle's handling will be different when cornering
The overtaking distance may be longer

comment:
Be aware that the additional weight of the passenger will make your motorbike more slow and shift the centre of gravity backwards. You will therefore no longer be able to corner quite as dynamically as without a passenger.
You should also be aware that the additional weight can make your overtaking distance noticeably longer.

question_text: What conditions must you fulfil to be allowed to carry a five-year-old child on your moped?

options.text: - be at least 16 years old
- fit the moped with a special child seat
- make sure that the child’s feet cannot get caught in the wheels

correct_answers.text: - be at least 16 years old
- fit the moped with a special child seat
- make sure that the child’s feet cannot get caught in the wheels

comment:
It is required by law that you must be at least 16 years old if you want to take a child under 7 years old with you on the moped. 
Since the child is under 7 years old, you must be able to attach a special child seat to the moped. The child's height and body control are not yet sufficient to hold on to the moped safely and independently. You also need to make sure that the child's feet cannot get caught in the wheels. There are special protective devices for this, such as: B. Footrests.

question_text: You are driving a truck with a trailer and wish to give someone a lift as a favour. Where are you allowed to carry such a passenger?

options.text: In the driver's cab
On the floor of the truck
On the floor of the trailer

correct_answers.text: In the driver's cab

comment: For safety reasons, you may only carry people inside the cab of a truck. Taking somebody with you on the load platform is not permitted. Only certain persons may exceptionally ride on the loading platform, if, for example, they are responsible for escorting the load.

question_text: What must you ensure before setting off on a journey in your car?

options.text: That the passengers can put on the existing safety belts
That you have an adequate view to the rear
That no objects (e.g. first-aid kit, road atlas, camera) are lying loose on the rear parcel shelf

correct_answers.text: That the passengers can put on the existing safety belts
That you have an adequate view to the rear
That no objects (e.g. first-aid kit, road atlas, camera) are lying loose on the rear parcel shelf

comment: The car driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers and the cargo. He/she must take all necessary measures to prevent or minimize damage. The loading must be carried out in accordance with regulations and must be carefully secured.

question_text: How are you allowed to transport a small child in your car?

options.text: In an approved child restraint with test mark
On the lap of an adult
In a baby carrycot on one of the back seats

correct_answers.text: In an approved child restraint with test mark

comment: Toddlers must be specially secured. This is only possible with an age-appropriate restraining device. This is to be mounted on the back seat. Infants are at risk to be suffocated by the airbag in the event of an impact. A baby seat is not secure enough.

question_text: How are you allowed to transport a five-year-old child in your car?

options.text: In a suitable and approved child seat with test mark
In a back seat with standard three-point safety belt
On a back seat with waist belt fastened

correct_answers.text: In a suitable and approved child seat with test mark

comment: If you want to bring a five-year-old child with you in your car, you must use a child seat that has been tested and adapted to the size of the child. This is mandatory for all children under 12 years.

question_text: How are you allowed to transport an eleven-year-old child of 140 cm (4'11") in your car?

options.text: On an approved raised seat with test mark and with three-point safety belt fastened
With three-point safety belt fastened
On a back seat with waist belt fastened

correct_answers.text: On an approved raised seat with test mark and with three-point safety belt fastened

comment: An eleven-year-old child that is 140 cm tall needs a children's seat or a booster seat. The child is to be fastened with the belt. Children under the age of twelve or under 150 cm tall must be carried. If the strap rests on the neck, there is a risk of strangulation.

question_text: What should be borne in mind when using an approved child seat with test mark?

options.text: The child seat must be appropriate for the height and weight of the child
The child seat must be capable of attachment to the seat of the vehicle for which it is intended
Nothing apart from the test mark

correct_answers.text: The child seat must be appropriate for the height and weight of the child
The child seat must be capable of attachment to the seat of the vehicle for which it is intended

comment: Child seats are made for different age groups. They are safety-tested for the specified weight and size groups. You should pay attention to this when using it. The child seat may only be used on those car seats for which it is suitable and approved.

question_text: Why is it dangerous not to wear safety belts?

options.text: Because you cannot adequately protect yourself in case of an impact at a speed of about 20 km/h
Because in case of an accident you can be projected out of the vehicle
Because of the low speed there is no danger in urban traffic

correct_answers.text: Because you cannot adequately protect yourself in case of an impact at a speed of about 20 km/h
Because in case of an accident you can be projected out of the vehicle

comment: In an accident, a person may be easily thrown out of the vehicle by the impact energy, or injured in the vehicle by a collision. Already at 20 km/h the impact energy is so high that injuries can occur.

question_text: At which impact speed must you reckon with serious or deadly injuries when no safety belt is worn?

options.text: From 30 km/h onward
From 50 km/h onward
From 80 km/h onward

correct_answers.text: From 30 km/h onward

comment: Without a seat belt, serious injuries can occur in a collision just over 20 km/h. This also applies to rear-end collisions which are often wrongly considered harmless. That's why you should always fasten your seat belt, even on short distances.

question_text: A car is equipped with two front air bags. On which seats must safety belts be worn?

options.text: On all seats
Not on the front seats
On the front seats only

correct_answers.text: On all seats

comment: The front airbags protect the car driver and the co-driver in the front seat in the event of a strong impact, for example a rear-end collision. However, they are not sufficient for comprehensive protection. All passengers must fasten their seat belts each time they drive.

question_text: What does this warning sign mean?

options.text: - you are not allowed to install a child seat opposite to the direction in which the vehicle is travelling
- you may only install a child seat facing the direction in which the vehicle is travelling
- you must install the child seat as illustrated

correct_answers.text: - you are not allowed to install a child seat opposite to the direction in which the vehicle is travelling
- you may only install a child seat facing the direction in which the vehicle is travelling

comment: The note warns against the wrong installation of the children's seat. If the children's seat is mounted so that the child sits in the opposite direction of travel, the child may be seriously injured in the event of a collision and the impact of the airbag. The children's seat must be installed in the direction of travel.

question_text: You wish to take several small children home after a children's birthday party. What must you observe when using your car?

options.text: The children must be secured with the prescribed child restraints
Child restraints need not be used within built-up areas
It is sufficient to secure the children with the existing safety belts

correct_answers.text: The children must be secured with the prescribed child restraints

comment: If you want to bring several small children home with your car, you must ensure that your passengers are secured in all places with the legally required restraining devices.

question_text: What must you observe if you wish to drive a vehicle with front passenger air bag?

options.text: You may not install a child restraint on the front passenger seat facing backwards
You may install a child restraint on the front passenger seat facing forwards
You may install a child restraint on the front passenger seat facing backwards

correct_answers.text: You may not install a child restraint on the front passenger seat facing backwards
You may install a child restraint on the front passenger seat facing forwards

comment: The children's seat must be facing forward. If it is placed in the opposite direction, the children's seat must not be used as the airbag poses a risk to the child in the event of an accident.

question_text: What is important to consider about headrests?

options.text: Adjust them to head height according to the operating manual
They are optimally adjusted by the factory
For the rear seats they replace the safety belts

correct_answers.text: Adjust them to head height according to the operating manual

comment: Head restraints must always be adjusted to suit the height of the occupants. Only then, can they best absorb the impact energy and protect the driver and other passengers in the event of a collision. However, the headrests do not serve as a substitute for safety belts.

question_text: While you are driving, the airbag control light stays on constantly. What must you do?

options.text: Go to a garage workshop
Take the vehicle off the road immediately
Nothing because it is an indication for the garage workshop

correct_answers.text: Go to a garage workshop

comment: If the airbag control lamp is lit up, it signals a defect in the airbag system. An error of this sensory and electronic system can usually only be fixed in a car workshop. This should be done as soon as possible. For this reason, you as a car driver do not have to immediately pull the vehicle out of circulation.

question_text: Are you allowed to transport persons on the loading platform of your truck?

options.text: Yes, if they must carry out necessary work
Yes, if they have to accompany the load
Yes, to secure the load

correct_answers.text: Yes, if they must carry out necessary work

comment: It is forbidden to carry persons on the load platform or in the shipping space of motor vehicles. A derogation applies, provided that these people have to do necessary work there. The ban also does not apply to the transport of construction site personnel within construction sites.

question_text: How can you prevent a child from opening a door while the vehicle is moving?

options.text: - the child safety locks on the rear doors
- the central locking system

correct_answers.text: - the child safety locks on the rear doors

comment: With the central locking, and child safety you can close all doors at the push of a button at the same time. This way you can prevent a child from opening the door while driving and thus being injured.

question_text: You want to carry a child in your car. When must you use a child seat for this purpose?

options.text: If the child is younger than 12 years old and is under 150 cm in height
If the child is older than 12 years old and is taller than 150 cm
If the child is older than 12 years old and is under 150 cm in height

correct_answers.text: If the child is younger than 12 years old and is under 150 cm in height

comment: You need a child seat if the child is younger than 12 years and smaller than 150 cm. If you do not have it with you, you risk a fine.

question_text: You want to drive with a baby in the passenger seat. What do you have to be aware of when using an infant carrier?

options.text: The infant carrier must be positioned reversed to the direction of travel
If installed, the passenger airbag must be deactivated
The baby must be strapped into the infant carrier

correct_answers.text: The infant carrier must be positioned reversed to the direction of travel
If installed, the passenger airbag must be deactivated
The baby must be strapped into the infant carrier

comment: The baby carrier must be placed against the direction of travel and the passenger airbag must be switched off to protect the baby. The muscles are not yet strong enough to absorb such a collision.

question_text: What should be noted when using a seatbelt?

options.text: The seatbelt should not be twisted
Once you have put it on, the seatbelt should be pulled tight
A damaged seatbelt should be replaced

correct_answers.text: The seatbelt should not be twisted
Once you have put it on, the seatbelt should be pulled tight
A damaged seatbelt should be replaced

comment:
The seat belt is the most important protective device of a vehicle occupant in the event of an accident. Therefore, when creating the seat belt, care must be taken that it is not twisted or damaged.
After putting on the belt, you should pull the belt once again to ensure that the seat belt sits properly.
If you determine damage to the seat belt, it must be repaired immediately.

question_text: What inhibits the operation of a three-point seatbelt?

options.text: Wearing a thick winter coat
Passing the belt under both arms
Not fully locking the belt into the harness buckle

correct_answers.text: Wearing a thick winter coat
Passing the belt under both arms
Not fully locking the belt into the harness buckle

comment: In order to ensure the maximum protective effect of the seat belt, it must be really cried out into the belt lock and run over the shoulder and hip. Performing the belt under both arms can lead to injuries. Furthermore, the function of the seat belt can be impaired by wearing a thick winter jacket, since there is a lot of air between body and seat belt.

question_text: What should you check before starting your journey?

options.text: - every passenger has put on their seatbelt
- I can ensure that I can properly observe other road traffic
- I have the registration certificate Part II with me

correct_answers.text: - every passenger has put on their seatbelt
- I can ensure that I can properly observe other road traffic

comment:
You should check some points before every start.
You should make sure that all mirrors are set correctly so that you can ensure sufficient traffic observation.
You should also make sure that all those traveling have created the seat belt, since the seat belt is the most important protective device in the event of an accident.
In the best case, you should keep the registration certificate Part II in a safe place and not carry it in the car. While you always have to carry the registration certificate part I (also called vehicle license) in the original in the car. The vehicle registration document documents the official approval for the participation of the vehicle in road traffic.

question_text: What should be noted regarding the desired protective effect of airbags?

options.text: Airbags can only achieve their full effect if the vehicle’s passengers are in the right seating position
The airbag deployment zone may not be encroached
Airbags can replace car seatbelts when driving in town

correct_answers.text: Airbags can only achieve their full effect if the vehicle’s passengers are in the right seating position
The airbag deployment zone may not be encroached

comment:
The prerequisite for the protective effect of the airbag is that it can develop properly. While the airbag unfolds, it is important that no objects or obstacles hinder the development.
The desired protective effect of airbags is only guaranteed if the passengers are upright and sitting on the back with their backs.

question_text: You want to transport a person in a vehicle, and that person must remain seated in a wheelchair during the drive. What must you be aware of?

options.text: The motor vehicle must be equipped with a wheelchair space
The wheelchair must be secured using a wheelchair restraint system
The person must be secured using a wheelchair-user restraint system

correct_answers.text: The motor vehicle must be equipped with a wheelchair space
The wheelchair must be secured using a wheelchair restraint system
The person must be secured using a wheelchair-user restraint system

comment:
Some points should be considered for the safe transportation of a wheelchair. Special passenger and wheelchair retention systems are used for this. Furthermore, there should be a special wheelchair parking space, at which, for example, anchoring points on the vehicle are attached to ensure the wheelchair.

§ 21a StVO
(1) prescribed seat belts must be created while driving; This also applies to prescribed wheelchair retention systems and prescribed wheelchair user retention systems.

question_text: You are driving a public transport bus. Where may you allow passengers to board and alight the bus?

options.text: At designated bus stops
At red traffic lights
At taxi ranks

correct_answers.text: At designated bus stops

comment: You are only allowed to let passengers get on and off the bus at the specified stops to be able to eliminate any danger.

question_text: As the driver of a public transport bus, what should you do when approaching a bus stop?

options.text: I steadily reduce my speed
I open the doors only after the bus has come to a stop
I turn on my indicator in plenty of time

correct_answers.text: I steadily reduce my speed
I open the doors only after the bus has come to a stop
I turn on my indicator in plenty of time

comment: When nearing a bus stop, it is important to switch on the blinkers and reduce speed smoothly. Do not open the doors until the bus has come to a stop.

question_text: You are driving a bus for the occasional carriage of passengers, and you are supposed to convey passengers and luggage. What must you observe?

options.text: Including the driver, it is only permitted to convey the maximum number of individuals as seats indicated in the registration certificate Part I
The loading of luggage may not result in the gross axle weight rating and the gross vehicle weight rating becoming exceeded
With duly stowed luggage, the gross vehicle weight rating may be exceeded by 10 %

correct_answers.text: Including the driver, it is only permitted to convey the maximum number of individuals as seats indicated in the registration certificate Part I
The loading of luggage may not result in the gross axle weight rating and the gross vehicle weight rating becoming exceeded

comment: Coming soon...

question_text: How are you allowed to transport persons on trailers used for agricultural purposes?

options.text: Sitting, if they are sitting on adequate seats
Standing up, if this is required to accompany the load
Standing up on empty trailers

correct_answers.text: Sitting, if they are sitting on adequate seats
Standing up, if this is required to accompany the load

comment: Coming soon...
